stem:
On this grid, find the dot with the circle around it. We can describe where this dot is by saying it is at First Number 1, Second Number 3

[Image: Coordinate grid]

Now find the dot with the triangle around it. Describe where the dot is on the grid in the same way. Fill in the numbers we would use:

First Number ____ Second Number ____
figure_description: A coordinate grid with a horizontal axis labeled "First Number" and a vertical axis labeled "Second Number". The horizontal axis has tick marks and dots numbered 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 with an arrow pointing right. The vertical axis has tick marks and dots numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 with an arrow pointing up, meeting at 0 at the origin. Grid lines form a square grid with dots at each grid intersection from 0 to 4 horizontally and 0 to 4 vertically. A circle is drawn around the dot at First Number 1, Second Number 3. An equilateral triangle is drawn around the dot at First Number 3, Second Number 2.
